channel.title: Tausig & Associates — Briefings
channel.description: Analysis and insight on digital evidence, OSINT methodology, AI detection, and investigative best practices from Tausig & Associates.

item.title: The Rise of AI-Generated Evidence in Litigation
item.description: AI-generated evidence in litigation is reshaping authentication standards. What California attorneys need to know about deepfakes, FRE 901, and Daubert challenges.

item.title: Meeting Daubert Standards for Digital Evidence
item.description: Digital forensic evidence faces unique challenges under Daubert. How to ensure your digital evidence meets the reliability threshold courts require.

item.title: OSINT Methodology: Beyond Screenshots
item.description: Pulling screenshots isn't an investigation. The difference between admissible intelligence and wasted effort comes down to methodology.

item.title: Digital Evidence Preservation: A Practical Framework
item.description: The window to preserve critical digital evidence is often narrower than attorneys realize. A practical framework for getting it right the first time.

item.title: The Evolution of Background Investigations
item.description: Background investigations have evolved significantly. What used to be a simple records check now requires a fundamentally different approach.

item.title: When to Engage Outside Investigators
item.description: Internal investigations handled by internal teams face inherent credibility challenges. Knowing when to engage an outside firm can make the difference.
